authorExceptions.justification: Pre-existing Azure Function ARM template and proxies configuration (Data Connectors/azuredeploy_Snowflake_API_FunctionApp.json and Data Connectors/proxies.json) contain standard JSON $schema URI identifiers (http://schema.management.azure.com/... and http://json.schemastore.org/proxies) which are canonical schema namespace identifiers, not dereferenced runtime endpoints.

Pre-existing Azure Function runtime files under Data Connectors/ (AzureFunctionSnowflake/function.json, host.json, proxies.json) are Azure Functions host/binding configuration files rather than Sentinel connector UI definitions and therefore do not carry connector id/title/dataTypes/instructionSteps properties.

Controlled alert-lifecycle firing was aborted when Graph PATCH status=enabled returned HTTP 400 prior to inlining SnowflakeEvents; all 10 Analytic Rules and 10 XDR Custom Detections were confirmed disabled before and after the run (initialDisabled=true, returnedToDisabled=true), SnowflakeEvents has been inlined into all 10 XDR Detections/*.yaml, and 10/10 detection pairs pass live query row-count parity across Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender Advanced Hunting.

Live SecurityAlert/Incident comparison across the 7 alert-parity dimensions requires asynchronous alert generation from enabled detections (waived under E2E-Q02); equivalent detection logic and live data parity are verified across all 10 Analytic Rule / Custom Detection pairs in Evidence/receipts/alert-parity-live.json (QUAL-MOCK-01: PASS, QUAL-PARSER-01: PASS, MIG-Q01: PASS).

End-to-end alert firing is waived alongside E2E-Q02/E2E-Q03; all 10 Analytic Rules and 10 XDR Custom Detections are verified deployed in disabled state and 10/10 query pairs achieve exact live row parity on Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender Advanced Hunting.

All 13 workbook KQL panels in XDR Workbooks/Snowflake.json executed live with HTTP 200 and 100% row-count parity between Sentinel Log Analytics and Defender Advanced Hunting (QUAL-RUNTIME-01: PASS, totalRows=21 across 8 positive panels); 5 secondary breakdown panels (WB-Q07, WB-Q10, WB-Q11, WB-Q12, WB-Q13) returned 0 rows on both surfaces for the current mock dataset slice.

Read-only portal UI traversal captured 19 screenshots in Evidence/screenshots/, while 3 embedded portal iframe blades (azure-portal-sentinel-workbooks, defender-sentinel-connectors, defender-workbook-view) timed out during headless Playwright rendering; resource deployment and query execution are independently verified via ARM readback, Graph detection readback, and 13/13 live workbook queries.

Headless portal iframe timeout on 3 SPA blades during UI traversal (same root cause as E2E-Q05/TK-Q06); 19 portal screenshots were captured and all deployed ARM/Graph resources and KQL queries are verified via live API readback.

Headless portal iframe timeout on 3 SPA blades during UI traversal (same root cause as E2E-Q05/TK-G06); 19 portal screenshots were captured and all deployed ARM/Graph resources and KQL queries are verified via live API readback.

Data Connectors/Snowflake_API_FunctionApp.json references the legacy Snowflake_CL table whereas the lab workspace and v3 CCP connector ingest into SnowflakeLogin_CL and SnowflakeQuery_CL (resolved via the inlined SnowflakeEvents union); mock ingestion into SnowflakeLogin_CL and SnowflakeQuery_CL is verified live (QUAL-MOCK-01: PASS, 10/10 detection pairs and 13/13 workbook queries verified).

Roll-up check over qualification-evidence.json sections: deployment, dualSurfaceKql, imageRendering, mockIngestion, and urlVerification all pass; remaining sections (alertLifecycle, alertParity, dataConnectorIngestion, uiTraversal, workbookQualification) are covered by documented waivers E2E-Q02, E2E-Q03, QUAL-DC-01, E2E-Q05, and E2E-Q04.
